name: prose-humanizer
description: Draft, rewrite, voice-match, and audit prose while preserving evidence and the writer's identity.

interface.shortDescription: Specific, truthful writing in your voice
interface.longDescription: Draft, rewrite, voice-match, or audit prose without inventing facts or flattening the writer. Prose Humanizer removes recurring generic patterns, preserves evidence, supports file-safe editing, and includes an optional transparent pattern linter that never guesses authorship.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this draft in my voice without adding any unsupported claim
Audit this draft for named generic-writing patterns without rewriting it
Turn these notes into a specific article using only the supplied evidence
